training_data: Salvora LoRa GPS dataset (2647 rows) + MUKUT hardware (60 rows)
preprocessing: None — raw RSSI and SNR fed directly as float32[2]
notes: v2 model trained on Salvora outdoor long-range + MUKUT hardware close-range
ML distances replace path-loss model in display layer only
Trajectory engine always receives RAW telemetry
v5 fitted range calibration overrides ML when active
SNR defaults to RSSI-derived estimate (SNR = RSSI*0.15+16.5) until hardware sends real SNR
Model input name is 'float_input' (different from v1)
